benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max, Fiedler, union, quarter-pi, classical-popcount, and repulsion-escape rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..117 were used in earlier rounds, except that k=100 and k=101 are the round-1 held-out instances and are not used. 130 and above stay unused.
forbidden: an energy-only union of two packings
a pi/4 or pi/2 shell displacement
using fidelity or a quantum eigenvector to score, start, or select
multiplying the L=1 QAOA grid the way round 3 did

families.nodata: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so K can nest. Not the claim.
families.K: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so KM can nest. Not the claim.
families.KM: original shared-gamma KM, interleaved triples, 3+3L, round-4 starts only
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 starts, repeats 0 and 1. This is the historical comparator.
families.qaoa_deep: the same QAOA circuit at L=6. Candidates are the historical L=6 vector plus sixteen extra energy-only starts. Not a new ansatz.

packing: interleaved triples [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). The same partition at every layer and at every N. FK = J@J with zero diagonal, rms-normalized. FM = block means on these triples.
qaoa_deep: L=6 only, after repeats 0 and 1. Eight starts draw each gamma uniformly from [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J] and each beta uniformly from [-2pi, 2pi], seed [20261296, N, k, s] for s=0..7. Eight starts add N(0, 0.75) to the energy-best historical L=6 vector and clip to the box, seed [20261297, N, k, s] for s=0..7. The historical vector is kept as a candidate, so the deep energy is at most the historical energy. No shell shift. No penalty.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer. QAOA is the usual independent-angle circuit.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient, true energy, no classical penalty

seeds.note: Standard starts use the round-4 integer prefixes. family_index is the position in family_order, so KM is 2 and qaoa is 3. The deep seeds are new. k=100 and k=101 are not used. Round 3's 3x L1 arm is not repeated.

continuation: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, perturbations 0.1 and 0.3, two ramps, and for QAOA the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). No third historical repeat. The sixteen L=6 starts are not continuation children.
selection: lowest true energy. Historical families use the lower of repeats 0 and 1. qaoa_deep uses the lowest energy among the historical L=6 vector and the sixteen extra starts. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in the starts or the selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_confirmed: all three N pass against historical QAOA
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes against historical QAOA and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_not_confirmed: N=6 does not pass against historical QAOA
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both historical repeats complete and the deep starts finished

diagnosis.role: frozen reading of the same instances. It does not rewrite the historical pass rule after the fit.
diagnosis.energy_drop: historical QAOA L=6 energy minus qaoa_deep L=6 energy
diagnosis.underoptimized: median energy drop > 0.01, or at least 4 instances have energy drop > 0.01
diagnosis.deep_pass: the same win rule with qaoa_deep as the comparator, equal depth, unequal search
diagnosis.reading_not_underoptimized_and_base_fail: The historical QAOA search was not the weak point on this sample. The miss is a KM result under energy-only selection.
diagnosis.reading_underoptimized_and_pass_changes: The historical comparator was thin: the heavier QAOA search moves the pass bit.
diagnosis.reading_underoptimized_and_pass_same: The heavier search moves QAOA energy, and the pass bit is the same as against the historical comparator.
diagnosis.reading_base_passes: Standard KM clears the historical comparator on this sample. The deep column says whether that clearance survives the heavier QAOA search.

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6. Within a job, repeats r=0 then r=1, and within a repeat nodata, K, KM, qaoa, depth 1 then 6. The sixteen deep starts run after both repeats.
